players.name: PhogsToffees

strengths.title: Getting shots off
strengths.coach: You kept finding ways to get shots off. Can't score 'em if you don't take 'em.

strengths.title: Goal threat
strengths.coach: Found the back of the net. Never gets old, does it?

weaknesses.detail: 28/42 passes (67%) - below the ~72% point where extra passes start costing rating
weaknesses.title: Forcing passes
tips: Below about 72% the extra passes start costing us. Pick the simple option until the touch comes back.
Through balls only when the runner is already moving and on the last defender's shoulder.
If nothing's on, keep it: shield, turn back, let the shape reset. Patience is a pass too.
weaknesses.coach: We tried to force a few too many. Not every pass has to be a love letter.

players.headline: Solid forward performance (7.7, above average for the position) - best at getting shots off, goal threat; work on forcing passes.

coach.name: Coach Lasso
coach.opener: Solid shift, PhogsToffees. A 7.7 clears the bar for a forward, and solid is the soil good things grow in.
coach.closer: I believe in you. More importantly, I need you to believe in you.

players.name: BellyTb1

strengths.title: Chance creation
strengths.coach: Made chances for your teammates. Unselfish football is the best kind.

weaknesses.detail: Tackle success: 0% (bottom quarter of midfielders is 18% or less)
weaknesses.title: Tackle timing
tips: Press to cut the passing lane, not to lunge at the ball carrier from behind.
Delay, deny, then dictate. Jockey goal-side and only commit when their touch gets heavy.
Every missed tackle leaves a runner free behind you. If you're not sure, contain and let cover arrive.
weaknesses.coach: Diving in a bit too eager. Patience in the tackle.

players.headline: Quiet midfielder performance (7.2, below average for the position) - best at chance creation; work on tackle timing.

coach.name: Coach Lasso
coach.opener: BellyTb1, a 7.2 is a touch under par for a midfielder. That's alright. Even the best tomatoes have a bruise or two.
coach.closer: Growth isn't a straight line. It's more like a squiggle. We're squiggling in the right direction.

talk.opener: 3-1 to Bubba Bros Fc. Be a goldfish about the result, keep the lessons.

well.title: Shot accuracy
well.line: 4 of 6 shots on target (67%). We picked our moments instead of swinging at everything.

well.title: Getting shots off
well.line: PhogsToffees: You kept finding ways to get shots off. Can't score 'em if you don't take 'em.

well.title: Goal threat
well.line: PhogsToffees: Found the back of the net. Never gets old, does it?

work_on.title: Tackling
work_on.line: Didn't win any of our 8 tackles. Stay on your feet, jockey, pounce on the heavy touch.
work_on.tip: Delay, deny, then dictate. Jockey goal-side and only commit when their touch gets heavy.

work_on.title: Passing
work_on.line: Passing at 69%, under the ~72% line where extra passes start hurting us. Simple and on the ground.
work_on.tip: Scan before the ball gets to you - a quick shoulder check means you already know the pass before you need it.

work_on.title: Defending as a unit
work_on.line: Conceded 3. When we lose it, everybody gets compact and goal-side - shape before chase.
work_on.tip: Get stuck in. A won tackle is worth about 0.2 rating, and even 1 in 8 pays for the attempts.
